checked: OSU text: Apr. 1, 1850, 9 Stat. 987, ratified Sept. 24, proclaimed Sept. 30, 1850; preamble admits the 148,000 acres were never received; $185,000 at $1.25 an acre, $100,000 invested at five percent, $85,000 paid.
